verdict.rationale: Intuit's official OAuth client and official QuickBooks Online MCP server both document a first-class sandbox/production environment switch, so integrations and agents can be built and tested against isolated sandbox company data instead of production. This is true environment isolation, not a dry-run mode. The MCP server's write-disable toggles are a separate scoping control and are not counted as the sandbox. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration that sandbox isolation works as described, and in-depth docs on sandbox company provisioning, data seeding and parity with production.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can test against a sandbox environment without touching production data

citations.quote: integrations are built and tested against isolated sandbox company data before touching production
